desc: The REAPER H-TAC by Fierce Firearms is a high-performance bolt-action rifle designed for precision and versatility. It features an aluminum chassis with a custom bedding design and a foldable, locking carbon fiber stock with an adjustable cheek piece. The rifle is equipped with a precision-machined, two-lug action with a 70-degree bolt throw, a TRIGGER TECH adjustable trigger, and an AccurateMag detachable magazine. It comes standard with a Fierce C3 carbon fiber barrel, NIX muzzle brake, and 0 MOA bases. The REAPER H-TAC is available in various calibers.
